extraction.notes: Reconciliation is on Attachment 2 (printed p.3, seq 10); all three-month 2Q 2024 figures. The FFO subtotal used is the diluted figure ($215,729), since the Series E convertible preferred distributions ($1,210) are added back in the FFO section for diluted FFO and the FFO as Adjusted and AFFO figures are built from diluted FFO; the basic FFO subtotal ($214,519) is therefore not the ffo_total. Series E distribution line is categorized as 'other'. 'Variable upside participation on DCP, net' shows '$-' (zero) for 2Q 2024 and is included as 0. The net gain/(loss) on sale line shows '-' (zero) for 2Q 2024. Check: 27,673+170,488+2,130+14,228+0+1,210=215,729; 215,729+5,395=221,124; 221,124-26,290=194,834; 221,124/356,747=0.62; 194,834/356,747=0.55; 215,729/356,747=0.60. Recurring capex is deducted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
